name: HAC Lab
affiliation: Dept. of Software, Kongju National University
tagline: On-device AI for physical agents that act in real-time, safely.
intro: We study On-device Physical AI: edge agents that perceive, decide, and act on their own onboard computers. Physical agents can carry out their tasks in real-time and safely, without relying on the cloud.
address: Seobuk-gu, Cheonan-si, Chungcheongnam-do, Republic of Korea
recruiting: We are looking for motivated undergraduate, M.S., and Ph.D. students. Please send your CV by email.
